title: What Could Go Wrong With Eaton Stock?

title: Is GE Aerospace's Lead Already In Its Stock Price?
summary: GE Aerospace (GE) earns the widest operating margin in a group of six peer companies, and it grows revenue faster than all but one of them. The market already charges for that lead. Yet over the past twelve months the stock has returned far less than RTX, a slower-growing rival. The quality is real. The question is how much of it you are already paying for.
